faqs.q: Do I need to install anything?
faqs.a: No. Pure web-based. Open in browser, supports Chrome / Safari / Edge.

faqs.q: Can I use the generated images commercially?
faqs.a: Absolutely. All AI-generated images are yours to use commercially on any e-commerce platform.
We cover 13 major platforms including Amazon, Temu, Shein, Taobao, TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada and more. Custom sizes also supported.

faqs.q: Can I regenerate if not satisfied?
faqs.a: Yes. You can regenerate for free until you're satisfied with the result.
Pro plan and above support batch processing. Drag in a folder and it queues automatically. Nighttime processing available (40% off).
